title: Field New Sales Executive - Service. Lifts, Escalators
description:
Lift Maintenance Service Contracts New Business B2 B Field Sales

Sell a Service You Can Actually Stand Behind

Are you a lift industry salesperson who's at your best opening doors and winning new maintenance contracts, but tired of fighting process, paperwork and a service team that lets you down?

Liftec Express, a leading independent lift and escalator specialist, is growing its sales team. It's looking for a genuine new business hunter to build its lift maintenance portfolio across the Kent & Sussex territory.

No up-to-date CV? No problem. This starts with an informal & confidential chat with Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing.

The Role at a Glance:

New Business Sales Executive
Field-based: Kent & Sussex territory

£50,000 £65,000 Basic DOE + £10,000 £15,000 OTE Uncapped
Car allowance + business mileage reimbursed monthly + company mobile
Full-Time Permanent

Leadership: Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing - ex Otis, Schindler, Lift & Engineering Services

Company: Independent lift and escalator specialist in maintenance, repair, installation and modernisation. Formerly part of Otis, now Private Equity-backed by R Capital

Ambition: £100m turnover by 2035

Focus: New Business Lift Maintenance Contracts Long-Term Client Relationships

Values: Doing the Basics Brilliantly Extreme Ownership Customer at the Centre Honesty & Integrity

Who We Are

At Liftec Express, we keep people moving safely and reliably, while building a company our team is proud of and our customers trust.

Previously part of Otis, Liftec is now an independent business with a big ambition: to become a £100m turnover company by 2035. We'll get there by giving property managers, facilities managers, building owners and main contractors outstanding service from a responsive independent partner.

Why More Salespeople from competitors Are Joining

Less red tape, more selling. You won't spend your week chasing approvals. Our quoting system is slick, decision-makers are accessible, and our MD will look at non-standard terms when there's a good reason. One of our recent hires, who joined from a major OEM, says producing a quote, seeing a customer and getting terms approved is far easier here.

A service you won't have to apologise for. Too often in this industry, salespeople win a contract that the service team then can't deliver. Not here. We do proper maintenance visits of around 45 minutes, not a ten-minute box-tick. We make proactive recommendations, manage shutdowns properly and take every customer issue seriously. You'll never look foolish in front of a client because operations let you down.

A team, not a lone wolf. Big companies often leave their salespeople to fend for themselves. Here, the sales team works together and pulls in the same direction, with real support behind you.

Room to grow. As we scale toward £100m, the sales structure will grow with us, including future leadership roles. Lisa will coach and develop strong performers every step of the way.

Earnings that reward results. You'll get a competitive basic plus commission paid on every lift you bring on contract. The best-structured deals earn the most, and good salespeople can earn very well.

A Word from Lisa

"I joined Liftec because it's an ambitious business with huge potential. It's fast-paced with a great team around you and everyone genuinely wants to help. I felt at home very quickly. We're independent, growing rapidly and there's a real opportunity for good salespeople to come in, make their mark and be part of what we're building."

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. There's no inherited account book and no renewals. Your mission is to win new lift maintenance contracts across a patch with thousands of lifts in it.

You'll:
- Build and manage your own prospect pipeline
- Target decision-makers across property management, facilities, building ownership and main contractors
- Take opportunities from first contact through to signed contract
- Conduct site visits and consultative customer meetings
- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial submissions
- Lead and complete tender submissions, including full commercial review
- Negotiate long-term maintenance agreements
- Keep your CRM pipeline and forecasting accurate
- Work with our operational teams to ensure a smooth handover once business is won

Lift service contracts are typically three years and are well written, so some opportunities mean keeping a prospect warm for the long haul. Others can be won quickly, and there are always one- and two-lift wins to be had. You'll need the drive of a hunter and the patience to build relationships over time.

About You

You'll already be selling lift service and maintenance contracts and know how the industry works. This role needs someone who can hit the ground running, so lift industry experience is essential.

You'll bring:
- A track record of winning new B2 B lift service & maintenance customers
- Strong prospecting and pipeline-building skills
- Consultative, relationship-led selling. SPIN-style approaches work really well here.
- The ability to understand customer pressure points and build trust over long sales cycles
- Strong commercial, negotiation and presentation skills
- Experience with proposals and tenders
- Good CRM and forecasting discipline
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel

Service sales here is about long-term relationships and understanding what keeps customers awake at night. It doesn't need the deep engineering expertise of modernisation sales. Our modernisation specialists work alongside you when those opportunities arise.

We're looking for people who are open-minded and inquisitive, take extreme ownership, put the customer at the centre and act with honesty and integrity. If that sounds like you, come and help us build what comes next.

Benefits:
- Competitive base salary
- Car allowance
- Pension from day one through Aviva
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one
- Death in Service cover at three times salary
- Discretionary sickness scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provision, subject to service
- Employee discounts platform
- Employee referral scheme
- Role-dependent incentive scheme

Ready to Open Doors?

Not actively looking, but curious? Good. There's no need for an up-to-date CV. Start with an informal, confidential conversation, and if it feels right, have a chat with Lisa.

Bring the relationships. Build the pipeline. Win the contracts.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Hays Collections Ltd Crawley
£26,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience + Bonus
Monday to Friday 9:00am 5:30pm
Office-based

Hays Collections Ltd is a growing B2 B debt recovery business based in Surrey, supporting companies across the UK with the recovery of unpaid invoices and commercial debts.

As we continue to expand, we are looking to recruit a motivated and confident Sales Executive to join our team.

This is a varied role focused on supporting the continued growth of the business through new client acquisition, outbound business development and the management of inbound enquiries.

The Role

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging with businesses that may benefit from our services, while also supporting the wider sales team with new business opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Proactively contacting prospective clients through telephone, email, LinkedIn and other outreach channels
- Identifying new business opportunities and generating qualified leads
- Speaking with business owners, directors and finance professionals
- Managing and responding to inbound sales enquiries
- Following up with prospective clients and maintaining strong relationships
- Clearly explaining our services, fee structure and debt recovery process
- Supporting the wider sales team with business development activity
- Maintaining accurate records of leads, conversations and follow-up activity
- Working closely with our collections team to understand client requirements and suitable opportunities

We are looking for someone who is confident, professional and comfortable communicating with businesses at all levels.

Previous experience within sales, business development or a B2 B environment would be advantageous.

Experience or knowledge of the construction industry, trade sector or businesses operating within construction and associated trades would be particularly beneficial, as a significant proportion of our client base operates within these industries.

The successful candidate will ideally be:
- Confident communicating with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers
- Comfortable with outbound prospecting and telephone-based business development
- Proactive and motivated to generate new opportunities
- Professional, personable and able to build strong relationships
- Organised with excellent follow-up skills
- Comfortable working towards individual and team targets
- A strong verbal and written communicator
- Able to work effectively as part of a close-knit team

Why Join Hays Collections?

Hays Collections is an ambitious and fast-growing business with a supportive and social team environment.

You will receive ongoing support and training from the wider team, with the opportunity to develop your knowledge of both sales and the commercial debt recovery industry.

As the company continues to grow, there will also be opportunities for progression and increased responsibility for the right person.

Salary: £26,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Bonus: Performance-related bonus in addition to basic salary
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:30pm
Location: Crawley office based

If you are a motivated sales professional looking to join a growing business where you can make a genuine contribution to its continued expansion, we would be pleased to hear from you.

title: Telesales Executive

description:
Telesales Executive

Salary 25,000 - 28,000 per annum + bonus up to 5,000, Burgess Hill, Monday to Friday 9:00am - 5:15pm, Permanent, 20 days annual leave increasing with service plus paid Christmas shutdown, Healthcare, Critical Illness Cover, Enhanced Pension, Salary Sacrifice Scheme, Death in Service Benefit

The Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Telesales Executive to join a well-established and internationally recognised manufacturer within the healthcare sector. Based in Burgess Hill with excellent transport links, this Telesales Executive position forms part of a small, stable sales and marketing team working from a newly refurbished office. Reporting into the sales and marketing function, you will play a key role in generating sales opportunities, supporting field-based colleagues and maintaining strong customer relationships. Full product training will be provided.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting a nationwide sales team by identifying and generating qualified leads
- Contacting new and existing customers to introduce products, promotions and campaigns
- Booking appointments for field-based sales representatives
- Maintaining and updating customer information within the CRM system
- Building strong relationships with customers over the telephone
- Following up on marketing campaigns and customer enquiries
- Identifying opportunities to increase sales activity and customer engagement
- Working towards individual and team performance targets
- Providing excellent customer service and product information
- Assisting with wider sales and marketing administration as required

Requirements

To be successful in this Telesales Executive role, previous telesales or sales experience is highly desirable. Experience within a healthcare, medical products or technical sales environment would be advantageous but is not essential as full training will be provided. Candidates should be self-motivated, organised and driven to achieve results, with excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Experience using CRM software is preferred, and familiarity with HubSpot would be highly desirable. The successful Telesales Executive will be comfortable working within a collaborative team environment whilst managing their own workload effectively.

This role could suit someone who has worked as Telesales Consultant, Internal Sales Executive or Business Development Executive.

Company Information

This organisation is a long-established manufacturer and supplier within the healthcare industry, serving customers across the UK and internationally. The business is known for its commitment to quality, innovation and customer service and continues to invest in both its people and facilities. Employees benefit from a supportive and collaborative culture, excellent staff retention and a modern working environment within a newly refurbished office.

Package
- Salary of 25,000 - 28,000 depending on experience
- Performance-related bonus of up to 5,000 per annum paid quarterly
- 20 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Paid Christmas shutdown
- Healthcare plan
- Critical illness cover
- Death in service benefit
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Salary sacrifice scheme
- Free parking
- Newly refurbished office environment
- Excellent transport links
- Full product training provided
- Permanent full-time position
- Monday to Friday working hours

Travail Employment Group is operating as an Employment Agency. Once you click to apply for this job your application will be immediately received by Travail Employment Group. If your application is successful a consultant will be in contact with you within the next 7 days. If you do not hear within 7 days you have unfortunately not been successful on this occasion.

title: Account Executive
description:
Location: Horsham (Office-Based Free onsite parking & near train station)

Career Path: Direct progression to Account Management & Sales

Ready to launch your commercial career?

At Global 4, we don t just offer a job; we offer a launchpad. If you are a confident communicator with a commercial "spark" and a desire to build a career in sales or account management, this is where your journey begins.

As a Account Executive / Client Support Specialist, you will be the heartbeat of our customer relationships. This isn't just about answering inbound queries it s a dynamic, commercial role where you will take ownership of a client portfolio, manage renewals, and uncover opportunities to grow revenue.

The Role

You will bridge the gap between world-class customer support and savvy sales. Working closely with our seasoned Account Managers, you will act as a trusted point of contact, ensuring our customers always have the right technology solutions at the right time.

This role is purpose-built for progression. We will teach you the ropes of consultative selling, product knowledge, and pipeline management, setting you up for a future promotion into a full Account Management or Sales role.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Account Development
- Be the Go-To Contact: Manage a portfolio of customers, handling both inbound enquiries and proactive outbound check-ins.
- Build Relationships: Welcome new clients to Global 4, review their services, and align their needs with our tailored solutions.
- Deliver Excellence: Handle service discussions confidently while maintaining a sharp commercial mindset.

Revenue, Renewals & Growth
- Protect & Grow: Take ownership of contract renewals to safeguard existing revenue while ensuring a seamless customer experience.
- Spot Opportunities: Identify and progress natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell our wider range of products and services.
- Drive the Pipeline: Accurately quote, close opportunities, and feed larger, complex leads to the senior Account Management team.

Pipeline Management & Progression
- Master the Process: Keep a structured, up-to-date pipeline of renewals and upgrades, ensuring all activities are accurately logged in the CRM.
- Level Up Your Knowledge: Learn the ins and outs of our multi-product portfolio, including connectivity, telephony, mobile, and IT services.
- Evolve Your Skills: Develop confidence in objection handling and consultative sales, positioning yourself for your next big career step.

What We re Looking For

We hire for attitude and train for skill. Previous experience in a customer-facing or sales support role is a bonus, but absolutely not essential full training is provided!
- The Ambition: A genuine, burning desire to build a long-term career in sales or account management.
- The Communicator: You are articulate, confident over the phone, and love engaging with people.
- The Commercial Mindset: You take pride in taking ownership of revenue, outcomes, and targets.
- The Organiser: Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple customer conversations and follow up proactively.
- The Attitude: Positive, eager to learn, and ready to thrive in a bustling office environment.

Why Join Global 4?

We are a family-run company that actually acts like one. We ve created an energetic, supportive environment where your hard work is celebrated and rewarded.

The Perks:
- Generous Leave: 33 days holiday (inc. bank holidays), a Buy & Sell scheme, plus up to 5 extra days rewarded for length of service.
- Tech Discounts: 50% off our Broadband & Utility packages (completely FREE after two years!).
- Health & Security: Death in service benefit, pension scheme, and eye care vouchers.
- Office Culture: Complimentary fresh fruit, bottomless tea/coffee, and the legendary "Friday Fridge."
- Rewards: Company lunches, fun team incentives, and our "Kudos" Employee Recognition Scheme.
- Giving Back: Paid Charity leave and a £250 "Bright Ideas" scheme.

Global 4 is proud to be an Equal Opportunities and Living Wage Foundation employer. We offer a fantastic working environment with numerous charity events, team-building days, and excellent training opportunities.
